$comment: Pinned external sources behind references/*.md. Written from research done on 2026-11-01; facts are restated in our own words in the notes. 'note' paths are relative to references/. 'license' is the licence of the upstream material, not of this file. excerpt_policy: link-only = cite the URL, copy nothing; facts-paraphrased = restate facts in our words; short-quote = quotes of 25 words or fewer, attributed with URL and access date; cc-by-excerpt = CC BY material, excerpts allowed with attribution; vendorable = permissive licence, files may be adapted with SPDX and Adapted-from headers. status: verified = read at the primary source on the access date; unverified = not read at source or only through secondary summaries. Optional 'skill' (an agent skill this repo may reuse): {name, path}, where path is the upstream folder holding its SKILL.md at the pin ('' = the repository root). How it may be reused follows excerpt_policy: 'vendorable' = may be copied in with SPDX and Adapted-from headers, NOTICE.md and REUSE.toml entries; every other policy = ideas only, read at the pin and never copied, installed in the project or run here (docs/LICENSING.md, External agent skills; references/README.md, External skills).
